assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 数据设施涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 数据交易、挂牌与估值数据仅有公开报道口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造交易额、挂牌量或估值数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified trading, listing, or valuation figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 数据目录与流通撮合均以匿名聚合与受控环境为边界，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Anonymized aggregation and controlled environments only; no individual-identifying tracking; human review for key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI生成的数据科普内容须经人工审核后发布，遵守版权与署名要求，不夸大数据要素作用、不把设想写成已确定安排。
assumptions.statement_en: AI-generated data-literacy copy requires human review; no overstated claims.

assumptions.statement_zh: 数据登记、授权运营与资产入表涉及数据要素政策与法规体系，本方案仅作概念建议，不构成政策或交易承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Data-element mechanisms are concept-level suggestions; no policy or trading commitment implied.
